subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this be handled as a core Gateway auth/protocol repair, a Trim OS package-owner issue, or kept waiting for logs before any auth/config behavior changes?
rationale: The possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing and shared-auth boundaries, and the reported config-regeneration component is not present in this source tree.

options.title: Collect proof before auth changes
options.body: Ask for a sanitized connect frame, Gateway logs around the 1002 close, exact CLI/Gateway/trim.openclaw versions, and before/after generated config before choosing an owner or repair.

options.title: Core diagnostic repair
options.body: If the logs show a current OpenClaw client produces an opaque protocol/auth failure, improve Gateway/CLI diagnostics and docs without loosening pairing.

options.title: Route package config management
options.body: If the only reproducible problem is the Trim OS app layer rewriting gateway.auth, keep OpenClaw core secure and route the config-management change to that package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before auth changes
recommendation.body: Ask for a sanitized connect frame, Gateway logs around the 1002 close, exact CLI/Gateway/trim.openclaw versions, and before/after generated config before choosing an owner or repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across Gateway protocol compatibility and auth logging on the affected path.
